fields.Name: T218 - Permissions App User Access Report Loads
fields.Description: Exercises the custom PermissionsUserAccessResource component's ngOnInit path — auto-selecting the current user and calling PermissionEngine.GetAllUserPermissions to aggregate effective permissions across all domains, then grouping them into accordion panels. This is a bespoke read-only aggregation surface, not the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the 'Permissions' application. It opens on the 'User Access' tab in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is seeing the 'User Access Report' surface render: a 'User:' picker dropdown at top (pre-selected to a user, since the current user is auto-selected on load) and either a summary line reading 'N permissions across M domains' with collapsible domain accordion panels below, OR a clear empty-state card ('No permissions' / 'No user selected'). You do NOT need to interact further — a rendered report or a valid empty-state is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Permissions app opens and the User Access Report renders with a 'User:' selector dropdown at the top
A user appears pre-selected and the page shows either a '...permissions across ...domains' summary with domain accordion panels OR a clearly labeled empty-state card
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
